archetypes.name: dyn-step5-cache
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 cached result reuse has subtle terminal-status routing risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 5 cached result-env classifier and wrapper harness. Focus on whether zero-rc stall envelopes are classified as restartable recovery state rather than reusable completion, and whether live-registry rejoin behavior still clears non-complete cached envs before waiting. Check that the regression test proves fresh bgjob start via wrapper stdout and bgjob-start argv rather than relying on mocked wait output. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
